name: chromacraft
description: AI-Powered Color Palette Extraction & Mood Adjustment

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd frontend && pnpm install
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.clean: cd frontend && rm -rf .next node_modules && cd ../backend && rm -rf __pycache__
